title: Positions
noAssistant: No available assistant to start a position conversation
prepareFailed: Failed to prepare the position workspace
openFailed: Failed to open the position conversation

wizard.title: New position
wizard.pickHint: Create from a project folder: its files are read first, then the proposal
wizard.emptyProfile: Nothing usable in that folder — try the deep AI analysis
wizard.aiUsed: Profile produced by the deep AI analysis (not human-checked)
wizard.idLabel: Position id (lowercase slug, the roster key)
wizard.antiJobLabel: Taboos (optional, one per line; a hit stops the task)
wizard.antiJobPlaceholder: e.g. never publish externally without the user's confirmation
wizard.bodyLabel: Instructions body (holds the project root line; editable)
wizard.colorPreview: Identity colour preview (derived from the id)
wizard.invalidId: The id is lowercase letters, digits and dashes only, starting with a letter or digit
wizard.overlapTitle: Overlaps an existing position — creating anyway is discouraged
wizard.overlapForce: I know about the overlap; create anyway
wizard.created: Created “{{name}}” — the roster picks it up shortly
wizard.emptyRoster: The roster is empty — use the + above to create the first position
wizard.describeLabel: Describe this position (what it does, what it owns)
wizard.describePlaceholder: e.g. Watch E:/Projects/freight-lab for me, parse and verify quotation sheets, acceptance is every row parsed and totals matching
wizard.describeGapTitle: Your description still misses this information — worth adding:
wizard.describeGapAllSet: Project root, duties and acceptance are all recognizable
wizard.describeSupervisorHint: Description unclear? Send the task to the Supervisor conversation — it interviews you one question at a time, like a business analyst

describeGap.project-root: Project root: which project does it own? What is the directory path?
describeGap.duty-boundary: Duty boundary: what is it responsible for, what does it explicitly not do?
describeGap.acceptance: Acceptance criteria: how good is good enough?

template.hint: Start from a community template (awesome-grokbot, CC0): search, adopt one, then edit the draft as you like
template.unavailable: Template catalog unavailable (not downloaded or the download failed)
template.errorDownloadFailed: The template catalog could not be downloaded (offline or the source is unreachable) — retry later
template.errorUnparseable: The downloaded catalog did not parse; the previous cache is kept
template.empty: No matching templates — try another keyword
template.nameHint: From a template: the name and description are pre-filled — a name fitting your task is worth typing

wizard.thinkingPlaceholder: None = no declaration (sessions keep their own)
